name: umbrella_yellow
notes: Original eight-gore yellow canvas with closed thickness, exposed timber ribs and stretchers.
Broad canopy underside and ribs clear 2.20 m; no low valance obstructs the walking band.
Central 32 mm pole, hollow 40 mm socket, and 28 mm ballast plate coordinate with the slim round café-table pedestal and feet.
Reference canopy is flattened slightly to preserve a useful walking clearance at this asset height.
